Closing: all 3 children are closed (1783-208c the removal story, 49ab-88e9 the docs story, 3360-ba7a the pyproject follow-up, landed as Gerrit change 3112, commit 6825490b649).

Checks on merged main (HEAD fedf819b2d2), 2026-10-25 14:51 PDT:
1. Criterion 1 (editor, Node and npm gone): 'rebar workflow edit' now fails with "invalid choice: 'edit' (choose from new, validate, run, show, status, result)"; 'python -c "import rebar.llm.workflow.editor"' raises ModuleNotFoundError; git ls-files | grep -c editor_assets prints 0; the wheel built by uv build --wheel has 972 files and 0 editor_assets entries; git grep for setup-node, npm ci/install/run and e2e-deps in .github and Makefile finds 0 lines, so no CI step needs Node or npm.
2. Criterion 2 (the two helpers keep their behaviour): pytest tests/unit/test_prompt_library_writes.py -q -> '26 passed in 3.23s'.
3. Criterion 3 (restore recipe, ADR, docs): the restore comment on yip-gem-teak (7013-447f-3084-4241) gives full 40-character SHAs (21dabcbb2c1fab1da7f81ccfd5a1aaedc2f2bdaf for the removal, 3fc67e5cd067c73b00e3f26d593b60dde632d0c0 for docs/workflow-editor.md) with a parent-commit checkout recipe; ADR 0071 is marked Superseded with commit 21dabcbb2c1. A correction comment added 14:4x PDT to yip-gem-teak states that 3112 also removed the pyproject artifacts entry, node_modules excludes and e2e marker that the original recipe said were never removed, and lists what a restore must re-add.

Unverified: the docs story's own grep assertions (changelog and release-notes wording) were not re-run in this pass.
